title: Pokiwiki
summary: A responsive Angular Pokémon wiki app with searchable Pokedex, team pages, and a reusable detail popup component.
highlights: Developed a responsive Angular web application for Pokémon content discovery with client-side routing and dynamic page navigation.
Built a custom Pokedex view that fetches Pokémon data from local JSON and displays searchable, filterable cards.
Implemented a reusable detail popup component using @Input()/@Output() for clean, component-driven UI interaction.
Integrated template-driven navigation and dropdown menus for team pages and informational sections.
Designed modular services and models for maintainable data fetching and state handling.
Applied polished UI styling and mobile-friendly layout for smooth user experience.
Hosted the site on GitHub Pages for fast, secure public access.

title: Personal Portfolio Builder
summary: Created a polished Angular portfolio app to showcase skills, experience, and project work.
highlights: Built a responsive layout with a clean UI for About, Experience, Skills, and Projects.
Added dynamic JSON-driven content so the portfolio is easy to update without code changes.
Implemented a smooth mobile-first experience with adaptive grid cards and navigation.
Incorporated reusable Angular components and service-based data fetching for maintainability.
Hosted the site on GitHub Pages for fast, secure public access.
